༄༅/ /pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i sgo nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub bsgrub pa dang slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga nag po 'gro shes bzhugs so

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i sgo nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub bsgrub pa dang slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga nag po 'gro shes bzhugs so// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rje btsun 'od dpag med/ /khros pa'i zlos gar pad+ma he ru ka /rig 'dzin dbang po mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs/ /rnam gsum dbyer med zhabs pad spyi bos mchod/ /mthar byed tsha gdung bye bas nyam thag rnams/ /pad+ma'i zhal gyi chu 'dzin las 'ongs pa/ /'dar char gdams pa'i bsil ba'i mchod sbyin 'dis/ /sems par gyis la 'chi med bde chen skyongs/ /'di au ḍi yan gyi mkhan po mahā ā tsar+ya pad+ma sam bha bas/ grub pa mchog gi ded dpon dpal ldan grub thob 'dar char la nags rgyal ri bo'i ngogs su gnang ba'i gdams pa 'chi med tshe'i rdzong chung du grags pa'i don gyi bcud phyung ba/ pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i sgo nas tshe'i dngos grub sgrub par byed pa'i thabs/ zab pa las kyang ches zab pa 'di nyid nyams su len pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ rnal 'byor pa rang nyid kyis rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du byas te/ tshe'i rig 'dzin bsgrub pa dang / skal ldan gyi slob bu rjes su bzung ba'i thabs bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ yang gsang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'am/ yab yum sbags sgrub bam/ dpa' bo gcig pa tsam gyi sgom bzlas sngon du song nas/ oṃ ram̐ kro dha rak+ṣa badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ tig sha bishwa dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes pas bgegs bsal/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhaḥ sarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar rma bya brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ paṃ las pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ aṃ s+ya dmar po/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ 'od zer 'phros 'dus/ pad+ma gaṇ+ḍa/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/

pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang / de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ 'od zer 'phros 'dus/ oṃ a ro lika s+yaṃ tā ga ra ti satwaṃ/ zhes brjod pas rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na rin po che'i bum pa 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ de'i spang na yum tshe'i lha mo gos dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bkra shis kyi mda' dar dmar po g.yab tu 'dor ba/ g.yon tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs pad+ma'i skyil krung gis yab la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku stod yan chad khebs pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin/ zhi ba 'dzum pa sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ de gnyis kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs dkar hūm̐/ dbus gnas lngar rat+na mu ku ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ zhes pas rin po che'i khang bu lnga'i nang du/ oṃ ma hā pra ti be ṣa dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ mahā a dar+sha dz+nyā na/ oṃ ma hā sa man+ta dz+nyā na/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na/ oṃ ma hā kri ta a nu dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas dbu'i rigs lngar rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad tshe dpag med yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs par bsam zhing / thugs rje'i lcags kyus thugs dam rgyud bskul zhing / /byams pa'i zhags pas gnas nas spyan yang 'dren/ /lcags sgrog bka' yi pho nyas rab bskyod de/ /'dir gshegs bzhugs shing rnam grol dges par mdzod/

/oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka tri sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / 'chi med tshe yi lha mo tsan+dha ma la sogs pa tshe yi rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang / lha dang srung ma'i tshogs thams cad phyag na bum pa dang thod pa la sogs pa tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba thogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs pa rnams kyis 'dzab dbyangs dang shis brjod kyi sgra sgrog bdud rtsi dang me tog gi char 'bebs par bsam mo/ /de dag la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes kyis/ /srid pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥ bi shwa mū ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba tad khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ne satwaṃ sa ma ya swā hā/ yang dag don du dag mod kyang / /'gro ba yongs kyi don slad du/ /phyag dang zhabs ni bsil nas kyang / /rdo rje gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ a ha ra a ha ra sarba bid dha ra pū dzi te na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ/ ga ga na khaṃ sa mā ye swāhā/ oṃ hriḥrā ga badz+ra/ puṣ+pe/ dhup+pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod dang / oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes pas bdud rtsi 'bul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa'i sna la sgo ma bzhi la sogs pa pho nya dpag tu med pa spros te/ de dag gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas/ rang gi snying gar nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus na tshe'i rten 'od dkar po mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam dkar la 'tsher ba'i dbus na/

rnam par shes pa'i rten yi ge nṛ ljang khu snum la 'gril ba dwangs shing gsal ba zhig yod pa la thim par bsam la/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /sku mchog mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /gsung mchog yan lag drug cu'i gsung / /thugs mchog mi rtog pa yi thugs/ /mkha' 'dra'i sku gsung thugs mnga' ba/ /tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig /rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye ma hā puṇ+ye a pa ra mi ta ā yuḥpuṇ+ye dz+nyā na saṃ bha ro pa tsi te swāhā/ zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi bh+rūṃ/ zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig brjod/ yang tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka nas lha mo lcags kyu ma dkar mo dpag tu med pa 'phros te shar dang shar lho'i phyogs su song bas/ dri za dang me lha la sogs pa lha klu gnod sbyin mthu bo che rnams kyi lag na rang gi tshe 'phrog pa dang 'thor ba dang yar ba la sogs pa ji snyed yod pa dang / shar dang shar lho'i 'byung ba'i rtsi bcud sogs/ gzhan yang 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas snying ga'i tshe rten la thim par bsam/ hūm̐ 'gugs pa'i lha mo lcags kyu ma/ /dkar mo mdzes ma lcags kyu bsnams/ /dri za'i lag nas tshe khug la/ /me lha'i lag nas dpal skyobs shig /oṃ puṇ+ye sogs sngar bzhin brjod/ lha mo zhags pa ma sngon mo dpag tu med pa spros pas lho dang lho nub kyi phyogs su song bas gshin rje dang srin po la sogs pa lha klu la sogs sngar ltar bsam zhing / hūm̐ 'ching byed lha mo zhags pa ma/ /sngon mo mdzes ma zhags pa bsnams/ /gshin rje'i lag nas tshe khug la/ /srin po'i lag nas dpal skyobs shig /sngar ltar brjod/ lha mo dmar mo lcags sgrog thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ nub dang nub byang gi phyogs su song bas chu lha dang rlung lha sogs dang /

hūm̐ sdom byed lha mo lcags sgrog ma/ /dmar mo mdzes ma lcags sgrog bsnams/ /klu dbang lag nas tshe khug la/ /rlung lha'i lag nas dpal skyobs shig /sngags brjod/ lha mo ljang khu dril bu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ byang dang byang shar gyi phyogs su song bas gnod sbyin dang 'byung po sogs dang / hūm̐ 'bebs byed lha mo dril bu ma/ /ljang khu mdzes ma dril bu bsnams/ /gnod sbyin lag nas tshe khug la/ /'byung po'i lag nas dpal skyobs shig /sngags brjod/ slar lha mo rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar thim par bsam/ bden pa brdar te tshe 'gugs pa ni/ mdun gyi 'khor bcas kyi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i pho nya nam mkha'i khams khyab par spros te/ de dag na yod pa'i lha srin mthu bo che rnams kyi rang gi tshe srog phrogs pa sogs dang / gzhan yang phyi snod kyi 'jig rten/ nang bcud kyi sems can/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yon tan nus pa mthu stobs la sogs pa thams cad skad cig nyid la bsdus te tshe rten la thim par bsams te/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa ste/ brgyud gsum rig 'dzin gyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sgrub sde chen po brgyad kyi lha tshogs sogs yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi bka' bden pa dang / khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i lha tshogs rnams kyiྎ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dguྎ 'khor za byed bka' nyan gyi tshogs dang bcas pa'iྎ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ bdag cag gi tshe sde brgyad rigs drug gi lag na gnas kyang khug cig

rdo rje chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis kyang / bdag cag gi tshe 'thor ba dang / yar ba dang / phrogs pa dang / ldig pa thams cad khug cig gzhan yang 'byung ba'i rtsi bcud/ sems can gyi tshe dang bsod nams/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi tshe/ tshe'i rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi rig pa'i tshe/ lha klu gnod sbyin mthu bo che rnams kyi las kyi tshe la sogs pa thams cad skad cig thang gcig yud tsam la khug cig drongs shig phobs cig stims shig oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥzhes lan gsum la sogs pa brjod/ de nas tshe bcing ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i nyi zla ga'u'i steng 'og tu rdo rje rgya gram bsams pa'i rwa rnams rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi thag pas bsdams par bsam/ tshe bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs brgyud zag med kyi bde chen gyis mnyes par byas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams ye shes dpal 'byor thams cad bsdus nas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gi bum pa'i nang du song bar bsams nas/ 'phro 'du'i 'od kyis bkug nas kyang / /ma lus bum pa'i bcud la bsdu/ /'chi ba med pa'i tshe thob nas/ /bla na med pa'i mchog thob shog /oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye mahā puṇ+ye a pa ra mi ta ā yuḥpuṇ+ye dz+nyā na saṃ bha ro pa tsit+ti swāhā/ zhes lan gsum dang / oṃ badz+ra ā yuḥṣe hūm̐ āḥ oṃ ā yuḥdz+nyā na sid+dhi bh+rūṃ/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci mang bzlas/ de nas mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das 'od du zhu nas phyag gi tshe bum la thim/ de nyid 'od du zhu nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub kyi ngo bo/ dpa' bo 'bru lngar gyur pa'i 'od dpag med dang / sor rtog ye shes kyi ngo bo yi ge am̐ dmar po/ mi bskyod pa dang me long ye shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po/

rin 'byung dang mnyam nyid ye shes kyi ngo bo swa ser po/ rnam snang dang chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ don grub dang bya grub ye shes kyi ngo bo hā ljang khu rnams su gyur/ de rnams rang gi spyi bo nas gnas lngar thim par bsam la/ hūm̐ yi ge 'bru lnga ye shes lnga/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni tshe yi bdag /'bru lnga rigs lnga'i rang bzhin dang / /sangs rgyas lnga yi dbang thob shog /oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃḥ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃḥ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hā+oḥ hoḥ tshe dbang du gyur cig dbang dngos grub tu gyur cig 'chi med kyi bdud rtsir gyur cig skye med kyi ye shes su gyur cig bdud las rgyal bar gyur cig mi shig pa'i rdo rjer gyur cig mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung du gyur cig mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig zhes brjod pa'i rang gi snying ga'i nyi zla ga'u'i rdo rje lu gu brgyud grol nas/ nyi zla ga'u kha bye ba'i nang du zhugs/ yi ge 'bru lnga po 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab bzhin pa tshe rnam shes kyi rten la thim pas/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa skad cig de nyid la byang zhing dag 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob/ slar yang ga'u rdo rje lu gu brgyud kyis sngar bzhin bsdam par bsam/ tshe sba ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud brtan g.yo thams cad la phog pas 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ de nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor la thim/ de tshe'i rten 'od dkar po la thim/ de rnam par shes pa'i rten nṛ yig la thim/ de nyid a dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar chos nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsams la yun ring du mnyam par gzhag cing / cis kyang mi tshugs mi bshig pa'i/ /stong pa'i go cha bla na med/ /chos kyi dbyings su tshe sbas pas/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs so/

/zhes brjod tshe brtan par bya ba ni/ 'od gsal gyi ngang las rang nyid sngar ltar tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis rgyas btab pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ tshe'i dngos grub brtan par bsam zhing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wak+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ tshe spel ba dang srung ba ni/ oṃ ā hūm̐/ 'dir tshogs skal ldan rdo rje'i bu/ /zhes pa nas/ bar chad bdud 'joms bkra shis shog /zhes pa'i bar gyi tshig ngag tu brjod cing don bsams pas legs par 'grub pa'o// ༈ //gnyis pa skal ldan gyi slob bu rjes su bzung ba'i tshul la/ rten bca' zhing bsgrub pa dang / slob bu la dbang bskur ba dang dngos so/ /dang po la rten bca' ba dang / bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ yang gsang khros pa'i dbang dang 'brel na dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs sam/ gzhan ji ltar 'os pa'i gnas chag chag dang byi dor byas pa'i gzhir/ dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dmar po/ 'dab ma dang mu 'khyud sogs ji ltar mdzes pa bri/ de'i steng du mañdzi la sogs pa'i khar snod gtsang ma nas sam 'bras kyis bkang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che dang rdza la sogs pa'i tshe bum gas chag med pa dar dmar po'i mgul chings dang bcas pa'i nang du/ sa'i snying po gser/ shing gi snying po bu ram/ rtsi thog gi snying po mar dkar/ 'bru'i snying po til dkar po rnams btab pa'i chu'i snying po chang gar mas legs par bkang / tshon skud sna lnga'i gzungs thag kyang mgul bar dkris la bzhag de'i steng du rin po che'i snod du spos sna tshogs btab pa'i chang gis sbrus pa'i tshe'i 'brang nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi rnam pa byas pa thabs dang shes rab mtshon pa'i brdar phyed dkar phyed dmar du byas/ dkyil du mar gyi rdo rje rgya gram bris/ de'i lte ba la bu ram gyi g.yung drung ris chos bskor du bya/

de'i dkyil du srog shing la brten pa'i mar ram bu ram gyi rdo rje phyed pa gzug mtha' la mi grangs dang mnyam pa'i phye mar gyi ril bus bskor/ gzhan yang mda' bya rgod ma sgro mes ma bzhur ba la/ dar dmar po kha ma nyams pa dang / me long dang g.yu rnams btags pa'i tshe 'gugs kyi mda' dar sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med cing phun sum tshogs par bshams/ gnyis pa bsgrub pa ni/ pad+ma dbang chen gyi 'phrin las gzhung bsrangs/ 'dzab bstod yan chad rdzogs pa'i rjes su/ bden stobs brjod cing mtshams sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ swa bha was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ tshe rten bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul chings dang ldan pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la nang gzhal yas khang chen po 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis gang ba/ de'i dbus su rma bya brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ zhes pa nas/ tshe bsdu ba'i bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/ 'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ tshe bsdus pa rnams mdun gyi tshe rten gyi lha'i thugs kar thim par bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ yang gsang gi dbang dang 'brel na/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'am bum dbang yan chad bskur ba'i slob ma rnams gral du 'khod pa la/ me tog bkye bsdu byas/ slob dpon gyis/ sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa dang / gnas skabs su dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag zhi nas/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sgo nas tshe'i dbang bskur ba zab mo zhus te nyams su len snyam pa'i sems bskyed pa gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir theg pa rim pa dgu las/

skyed pa mahā yo ga'i chos skor/ de la sgrub sde chen po brgyad yod pa las pad+ma gsung gi chos skor/ de la yang phyi nang gsang gsum gyi chos skor rnams las ches khyad par du 'phags pa/ nying khu'i bcud byung ba lta bu yang gsang khros pa'i sgo nas tshe'i dngos grub sgrub par byed pa la/ phyi zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa dang / nang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i lugs gnyis yod pa las/ 'dir khro bo'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i lugs yin no/ /de yang o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis grub thob pa mchog gi dbang po dpal ldan 'dar char la/ nags rgyal ri bo'i ngogs su zhal mngon sum du bstan nas/ 'di nyid kyi dbang dang gdams pa yongs su rdzogs par gnang ba de nyid nas bzung ste/ dus deng sang gi bar du bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la tshig dang don gyis brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i byin rlabs kyi bka' babs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa lags/ de lta bu'i tshe'i dbang bskur ba sgrub pa'i rdo rje slob dpon ni/ rab rlung sems la dbang thob cing / yi dam lha'i rtags dang mtshan ma mngon sum du ston nus pa/ 'bring byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan zhing yi dam lha'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa/ tha ma'ang 'dir dbang bskur ba thob cing / cho ga'i lag len la mkhas pa zhig gis bsgrub par gsungs/ gang la bsgrub pa'i slob ma ni/ bla ma dang chos dang gdams ngag la yid ches pa/ khyad par 'di nyid la ched du mos pa zhig la bsgrub/ dgos pa ni/ tshe nyams pa gsos nas tshe'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i don du bsgrub pa yin/ de yang tshe nyams pa'i rgyu ni/ dpal bdud rtsi 'khyil ba tshe'i rgyud las/ dam can sems dkrugs sngags pa yi chad dang / /zhe sdang drag po rbod gtong khar babs dang / /rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam nyams dang / /gnas min gnas bcas gyur pa 'di dag ni/

/tshe yar dbugs dngangs bgegs kyi dbang du gyur/ /dgra dbang gyur dang mkha' 'gros gtses/ /rbod gtong khar phyin dus min 'chi/ /tshe nyams pa yi rgyu ru bshad/ /ces gsungs/ rgyu de rnams la brten nas tshe nyams pa'i rtags ni/ rgyud de nyid las/ gzi brjid med dang lus nyams bral/ /mdog nyams bya ba dor ba dang / /yid mi bde dang lci nyam chung / /tshe nyams pa yi rtags su bshad/ /ces pa dang / yang / 'khor la khro zhing sdug skad 'byin pa dang / /bzhin 'gyur spyod lam 'chal bar 'gyur ba dang / /slob dpon 'tsho byed dus las g.yel ba dang / /kha zas dag kyang yid khar mi 'ong dang / /'di dag tshe nyams pa yi rtags su bshad/ /ces gsungs/ de lta bu'i tshe nyams pa'i rtags byung ba'i gang zag gi tshe sring bar byed pa'i thabs ji snyed bsgrub pa'i cho ga'i rim pa ni/ slob dpon chen pos tshe yi dbang byang las/ tshe nyams pa las bsrung 'dod pas/ /dbang dang sgrub pa'i dus dag tu/ /maṇ+ḍal bri zhing tshe rdzas gsog /sgrub po nus dang ldan pa yis/ /dbang chen 'phrin las gzhung bsrangs shing / /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ mdun du tshe rten mchod pa sogs kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs par bshams/ slob dpon rang nyid kyis yang gsang khros pa'i 'phrin las 'dzab bstod kyi bar dang / tshe rten bskyed cing tshe dgug bcings rten la bsdu ba rnams legs par grub nas/ khyed rang rnam pa'i ngo skal du gyur pa'i tshe'i dbang bskur bsgrub pa la/ thog mar tshe byang las/ tshe la bar chad bgegs rnams bskrad/ /zhes gsungs pas/ slob dpon yang gsang khros par gsal ba'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi khro bo mtshon cha thogs shing / sngags kyi sgra sgrog pa me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrug pa dpag tu med pa mched/ khyed rang rnams la tshe'i dbang bskur ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad cing tshar bcad pa'i mos pa mdzod/

na mo/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ zhes pa nas/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis bdag cag rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la tshe'i dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs/ mi min mi ru brdzu ba/ lha min lha ru brdzu ba/ gsang sngags zab mo nyan pa la mi dbang ba gang yin pa de dag thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par rgyang ring du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ye shes kyi khro bo rab tu 'bar ba 'di rnams kyis skad cig nyid la rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya'o/ /oṃ ram̐ kro dha sogs tsham sngags brjod cing / gu gul gyi du ba dang rol mo'i sgra chen po bsgrags/ de ltar bgegs bskrad nas tshe rten lha ru bskyed bya zhing / zhes gsungs pa'i nyams len/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas 'di nyid na/ tshe rten tshe bum dang bcas pa 'od gsal gyi snang ba las grub pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal zhes pa nas bskyed cing spyan drangs pa la/ mchod pas mchod pa'i gong ltar byas/ de ltar lha gsal btab cing mchod pa'i rjes su/ bstod la zhabs su tshe 'gugs gdags/ zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rdo rje tshe yi rten gyis mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das yab yum la bstod pa byas pas thugs mnyes pa'i thugs ka nas sgo ma bzhi la sogs pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa spros te/ 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud thams cad bsdus nas tshe rten la thim par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan mgon po 'od dpag med/ /nas/ rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /oṃ puṇ+ye sogs tshar gsum gdangs dang bcas pa brjod/ oṃ badz+ra āḥyuḥṣe hūm̐ āḥ oṃ āḥyuḥdz+nyā na sid+dhi bh+rūṃ/ zhes pa'ang ci rigs pa brjod/ tshe dgug pa dngos ni/ thugs las sgo ma bzhi spros te/ bskul ba sngags dang bcas pas dgug /ces gsungs pa'i nyams len/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyi thugs ka nas/

lha mo dkar mo lcags kyu thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ zhes pa nas/ phobs shig stims shig oṃ āḥyuḥdz+nyā na dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pa'i bar gong ltar brjod/ sngags rnams kyi skabs su 'dzab dbyangs bya zhing mda' dar gyi g.yab mos g.yob/ tshe bcing ba ni/ nyi zla ga'u rdo rje'i ras/ /bsdams la bzlas pa bya zhing bsdu/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus na/ tshe'i rten 'od dkar po mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam dkar la 'tsher ba'i dbus na/ rnam par shes pa'i rten yi ge nṛ ljang khu snum la 'gril ba dwangs shing gsal ba zhig yod par bsam/ ga'u phyi nas steng 'og tu rdo rje rgya gram bsams pa'i rwa rnams rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi thag pas bsdams par bsam/ bzlas pa bya zhing tshe bsdu ba ni/ 'phro 'du'i 'od kyis bkug nas kyang / /ma lus bum pa'i bcud la bsdu/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don slob dpon gyi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas bum pa'i nang gi bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad bsdus nas/ mdun bskyed la thim par bsam/ mda' dar g.yab cing / 'phro 'du'i 'od kyis bkug nas kyang / /ces sogs sngags dang bcas pa gong ltar ci mang brjod/ dngos gzhi tshe'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sngon du song nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig bdag la 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub bstsal tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ tshe byang las/ bum lha zhu nas tshe la thim/ /de dag dpa' bo 'bru lngar gyur/ /mar me gnyis bye'i tshul du ni/ /gnas lngar bkrams shing tshe dbang bskur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud thams cad tshe'i rten la thim/

de nyid bum pa'i lha la thim/ bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i nang gi snying po lnga la thim/ de rnams zhu ba las dpa' bo 'bru lngar gyur pa ni/ 'od dpag med dang sor rtog ye shes kyi ngo bo yi ge am̐ dmar po/ zhes pa nas/ don grub dang bya grub ye shes kyi ngo bo hā ljang khu rnams su gyur/ de rnams las de 'dra ba'i yig 'bru lnga po mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam par mched nas khyed rang rnam pa'i spyi gtsug la sogs pa mgo bo'i gnas lngar thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yi ge 'bru lnga ye shes lnga/ /zhes pa nas/ mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig /ces pa'i bar brjod cing tshe bum tshe 'brang dang bcas pa lhan cig tu btegs nas slob ma'i mgo bo'i gnas lngar bzhag snying ga'i nyi zla'i ga'u'i rdo rje lu gu rgyud grol nas/ nyi zla ga'u kha bye ba'i nang du zhugs/ yi ge 'bru lnga po 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab bzhin pa/ tshe dang rnam shes kyi rten la thim pas/ de nyid 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin du gsal bas dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa skad cig de nyid la dag 'chi med tshe'i dbang bskur ba thob par bsam/ tshe sba ba ni/ tshe byang las/ cis kyang mi tshugs mi bshig pa'i/ /zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gsungs pa'i don/ slob dpon gyis/ sngar gyi tshe 'gug pa'i mda' dar gyi ltong la mda' dar dkris la/ slob ma'i snying gar bzhag cing / snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud brtan g.yo thams cad la phog pas 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ de nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor la thim/ de tshe'i rten 'od dkar po la thim/ de rnam par shes pa'i rten nṛ yig la thim/ de nyid a dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ de yang nam mkha' la 'jal yal ba ltar/ chos nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsam la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag par mdzod/ cis kyang mi tshugs mi bshig pa'i/ /sogs brjod/ tshe brtan par bya ba ni/

tshe brtan sku gsung thugs su brtan/ /zhes gsung pa'i don/ 'od gsal gyi ngang las zhes pa nas/ badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ gi bar gong ltar brjod/ de'i rjes su tshe spel ba ni/ tshe spel bkra shis brjod cing spel/ /ces gsungs pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas na bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma tshe'i lha dang drang srong gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa rnams dang / gzhan yang / nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa 'khor bcas/ pad+ma dbang gi zhing khams nas khro rgyal pad+ma dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ lho nub rnga yab dpal ri'i gnas nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas 'chi med tshe'i lha mo tsan+dha li la sogs pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor ba/ gzhan yang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas/ sprin gyi phung po 'thibs pa'am bya'i khyu chen po 'phur ba bzhin du mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su byon nas/ de dag gis shis brjod dang 'dzab dbyangs kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog cing / me tog dang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi char chen po 'bebs par bsgom mdzod/ ces brjod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dir tshogs skal ldan rdo rje'i bu/ /zhes pa nas/ mched lcam dag pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /gnas 'dir byon la bkra shis stsol/ /zhes brjod cing sh+lau ka re'i mtshams su puṇ+ya'i 'dzab bya/ dril bu gsil zhing me tog 'thor/ de nas slob ma rnams lag pa bsnol ba'i g.yas su tshe 'brang dang / g.yon du tshe bum bzhag la/ lag gnyis pad dkar bzhad pa'i rtser/ /zhes pa'i sh+lau ka gcig 'dzab dang bcas pa bya/ de bzhin du/ tshe'i ril bu byin la/ dpal gyi zas mchog ces sogs dang 'dzab bya/ tshe chang byin la/ snying po lnga ldan zhes sogs dang 'dzab bya/

tshe sring skye 'chi med pa bsrung / /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ snying kha nas tshe'i rten yod pa'i rtsa sgo smin mtshams su zla gam dmar po me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du/ dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas tsan dan gyi be con dang / g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbu gtsug na rta mgo ljang khu 'tsher ba/ khro bo'i nyams thams cad rdzogs pa/ dur khrod kyi chas thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gyad kyi dor stabs can cig bzhugs pas tshe'i bar chad thams cad/ bsrung bar bsams la/ a wa dhu ti'i sgo 'phar na/ /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig 'dzab dang bcas pa brjod cing / sin+dhu ras smin mtshams su thig le bya/ de dag gis tshe'i dbang bskur ba legs par thob pas bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu zhes brjod la maṇ+ḍal dbul/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ tshogs dang lhag ma gzhung bzhin bya/ /snod ldan ma yin pa la gsang / /snod ldan rnams dang 'phrad par shog /ces gsungs pas/ dpon slob thams cad tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston gyis tshim par bya zhing / 'di lta bu'i zab chos snod min la byung rgyal du mi spel zhing / snod ldan la dpe 'khyud med par sbyin pa sogs gnas skabs shes pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don bsgrub par bya'o/ /'di ltar tshe'i dbang bskur ba zab mo 'di nyid shin tu grags che zhing / rjes 'brang so so'i bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang du 'dug na'ang / slob dpon chen pos grub thob 'dar char la dngos su gnang ba'i 'chi med tshe'i rdzong chung tshe chang du grags pa'i yi ge gzhir bzhag de'i nyams len gsal byed kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa'i dbang chog gis gsal bar byas/ bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi phyag len gyis kha bskangs/ gzhung dang mi 'gal zhing / dgongs par 'gro nges pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa cung zad kyis mtha' brgyan nas/ don la rang bzo'i dri mas ma gos par bkod pa yin pas/

gang zag so sos bsre slad dang dbri bsnan mi mdzad pa zhu/ slob dpon chen po tshe byang gzhir byas shing / /lugs 'di'i srol 'byed chag ston yi ge bzhin/ /legs par bkod pa'i tshe sgrub dbang chog 'dis/ /skal bzang dpyod ldan rnams kyis nyams len mdzod/ /de lta'i tshad ldan gzhung gi yi ge dag /mig dang rna ba'i yul du ma son pa'i/ /rang blos sbyar ba'i yi ge lag len rnams/ /rgyas bsdus mang yang de la dgos pa ci/ /'di sbyar dge ba'i sprin dkar phung po las/ /legs 'ongs gsang chen char rgyun gsar pa 'dis/ /dus min 'chi ba'i tsha gdung kun bsal nas/ /'chi med bdud rtsis yun ring 'tsho bar shog /ces pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i sgo nas/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs nag po 'gro shes kyi tshul du bkod pa 'di ni/ yang gsang khros pa'i rnal 'byor pa blo gsal rgya mtshos/ gnas mchog dpal gyi zab bu lung bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang du legs par sbyar ba'i dge bas bdag gzhan rnams kyi tshe'i bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bde blag tu 'grub par gyur cig /'di'i yi ge pa ni/ rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyi sku drin kho nas 'tsho ba'i btsun pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug go/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub bsgrub pa dang slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga nag po 'gro shes/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
